postureExplain.calm: The market is relatively stable. A good time to study, not to react to every tick.

postureExplain.storm: Elevated stress. Cut noise, avoid FOMO, confirm causes in the analyses.
postureExplain.weird: Signals disagree. Don't trust a single metric — demand context.

case.title: From seven tabs to a 12-minute ritual.
case.body: An independent operator juggled CoinGecko, Twitter, funding and news. With CLAREZA Crypto, morning orientation lands in one desk — and deepens only when a case justifies it.
case.quote: I stopped reacting to the first green chart. Now I open the desk, read the alert, then decide if it’s worth digging.
